facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Focus: 科技创业 / 各地产业方向
facts_raw.Funding / Support: 孵化服务、天使投资、创业培训、开放平台；启迪之星创投和“壹计划”会从孵化/创业营项目中另行筛选投资
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Separate TusStar Ventures / 壹计划 selection
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Base/location-specific; national network covers early technology companies with local industrial themes.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.Format: 孵化空间 + 创业服务 + 产业资源
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 北京 + 全国多城市 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Network active; individual incubator intake varies by city/base
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: do not present TusStar as one standardized accelerator. It is a 200+ base incubation network with separate investment vehicles.

facts.Funding / Support: Incubation, angel investment, founder training and an open platform. TusStar Ventures and the One Plan initiative select investments separately from incubation and camps.
facts.Funding Trigger: Separate selection by TusStar Ventures or the One Plan initiative.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Base/location-specific; national network covers early technology companies with local industrial themes.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.Format: Incubation facilities, founder services and industry resources.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for Beijing and other Chinese cities.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Status: Network active; individual incubator intake varies by city/base
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Early stage stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: Foundshore: do not present TusStar as one standardized accelerator. It is a 200+ base incubation network with separate investment vehicles.
